column1: # quality-vps-kit endpoint list. One endpoint per line:
# Lines starting with # and empty lines are ignored. Use your own copy with
# `qvk run --endpoints FILE`. Only https:// URLs are accepted.
#   echo4      returns the caller's public IPv4 (plain body or Cloudflare trace "ip=")
#   baseline   neutral HTTPS endpoints for DNS/TCP/TLS/HTTP timing
#   rtt_ru     hosts in Russia: TCP handshake RTT from the VPS towards Russia.
#              This is the route from the VPS, NOT reachability from a Russian
#   ai, media, ru_hosted   HTTP reachability checks (QVK-04)
# Keep requests gentle: small documents (robots.txt, 204 endpoints, traces).
# Verify that the URLs still behave as expected before relying on them.
